title: Mushroom Witch Apothecary
description: A blue-skinned witch with a green snake coiled around her body and a glowing crescent moon headdress stands behind a wooden apothecary counter. She holds a glowing green rune in her hand while red and orange smoke rises from a potion bottle, surrounded by large glowing red-capped mushrooms, scrolls, and mystical symbols under a red moon.
prompt: A mystical blue-skinned sorceress with a large green snake coiled around her torso and a glowing crescent moon headdress stands at a wooden apothecary counter at night. She holds a glowing green rune while colorful smoke rises from potion bottles. Large luminous red-capped mushrooms with green glowing stems grow from the counter. A blood red moon and bare trees are visible through an arched window. Scrolls, runes, and mystical symbols float in the air, dark fantasy style, intricate details, atmospheric lighting.
